title: AEF 1.0: run plan
description: READER (tolerant), derived from the writer schema by tools/derive_reader.py. What a runner is asked to evaluate: the exact subject version, the suites and lanes, the limits, what text the runs keep (contentCapture), where and how it runs, and the credentials it needs, as references only (PLAN-1 to PLAN-5).

schemaVersion.description: The AEF version this document follows, MAJOR.MINOR: 1.0 for AEF 1.0 (VER-1).

planId.description: The plan's id. With the digest of the plan file's bytes, it identifies the plan (PLAN-5).

checkpointId.description: The checkpoint the plan gathers evidence for, when there is one.

subject.description: Resolved and immutable: 'latest' is resolved before the plan exists.

ref.description: The subject to evaluate, as a typed reference (PLAN-1).

version.description: The subject's exact version; never latest (PLAN-1).

image.description: The OCI image manifest digest of an already-built image.

deployment.description: Where the subject is deployed, as a typed reference.

endpoint.description: Where the subject answers. Never carries credentials (no user:password@).

repository.description: Where the image is pulled from (registry/name), when it is.

suites.description: The suites to run, each with an exact version and the lane it serves.

ref.description: The suite, as a typed reference.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the suite's content, when it is frozen.

limits.description: Hard limits the runner enforces: it stops before exceeding them, and says so in the event stream.

maxUsd.description: The most the runner may spend, in US dollars. Always set; spend equal to it is within it (PLAN-2, STRM-3).

cases.description: The most cases the runner may complete, when set (PLAN-2).

timeout.description: ISO 8601 duration in hours and minutes (PT2H, PT30M).

contentCapture.description: What text the runs keep: off or on, as run.json's contentCapture (RUN-11). Every run the runner produces carries this value (STRM-4).

isolation.description: How the run is isolated: process, container (an already-built image, named by digest) or remote-zone (in the network zone given by zone) (PLAN-1).

provider.description: Where the run executes: local, docker, k8s or ci:<name>. A runner that does not support it, or does not know it, refuses the plan (PLAN-7).

credentialRefs.description: What the runner resolves where it runs, and gives to the process the purpose names as an environment variable called name. A plan holds references, never secret values.

name.description: The environment variable the value is given as.

scheme.description: Where the value lives: env (an environment variable), keychain or vault. A runner refuses a plan with a scheme it does not know (PLAN-3, PLAN-7).

path.description: The variable, keychain entry or vault path: a name, never the value.

purpose.description: What the credential is for: subject, judge, attacker, evaluator or other. The runner gives the value to the process this names, and refuses a purpose it does not know (PLAN-3, PLAN-7).

runnerSelector.description: Tags a runner's capability manifest must all carry.

ext.description: Producer extensions, named reverse-DNS or with the producer's prefix. A reader ignores what it does not know; never holds a secret (ENC-19, PLAN-4).

zone.description: The network zone a remote-zone run must execute in.

judges.description: The judge models and rubrics the evaluators use, fixed by the plan.

model.description: The judge model the evaluators must use.

rubricDigest.description: The SHA-256 of the rubric the judge must grade with.

baseline.description: What a comparison lane compares against: a policy, or one sealed run.

comparability.description: The comparability axes a comparison lane uses, fixed by the plan so the runner cannot pick them.

required.description: The axes on which a comparison lane's runs must match their baseline (spec 05, LANE-6).

allOf.description: A container run evaluates an already-built image, identified by digest.

subject.description: A container run names its image by digest (PLAN-1).

allOf.description: A remote-zone run names its zone.
